verdict.rationale: Alma documents a client portal where applicants complete online questionnaires (alma-docs-16). The homepage promises a system that "gives you clear visibility at every step" and flags risk early (alma-docs-14). The pricing page offers "Visibility and control" on its Growth tier (alma-docs-15). However, the visibility claims are framed for employers managing immigration programs, and the portal is only described as a place to fill in intake questionnaires, not a case-status dashboard for an individual founder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an applicant-facing case status tracker, documented next-steps/timeline view in the portal, screenshots or detailed portal docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
